tasks.title: Create production architecture skeleton
tasks.description: Create Kotlin hexagonal and Angular clean-architecture boundaries for the production core. Keep fixture prototype isolated from storefront production.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: domain has no framework imports
AC-2: production storefront repository is HTTP-bound, not fixture-bound
GATE: architecture scan passes

tasks.title: Create core single-tenant Flyway schema
tasks.description: Create the documented core schema for one merchant installation. Exclude deferred business/integration persistence except typed DISABLED capability registry/configuration rows. This task contains zero BlackStore persistence, API, adapter or service identity; the separate producer-contract WIP cannot satisfy this task.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: schema has zero store_id/store_hosts and zero deferred business/integration objects except typed DISABLED capability registry/configuration rows
AC-2: installation_settings permits only installation_id=1 and startup fails closed when it is absent
AC-3: checkout PENDING claim holds immutable snapshot before an order; composite claim/order reference preserves customer/key/request hash and replay/ownership checks are testable
AC-4: immutable envelopes are separated from worker processing/delivery projections
AC-5: reservation saga/line keys differ from ledger event idempotency keys and expiry is transactionally testable
GATE: Flyway/Testcontainers migration passes
AC-6: startup fails closed/unready with INSTALLATION_NOT_PROVISIONED when the sole row id=1 is absent
AC-7: database triggers reject protected fact/envelope UPDATE/DELETE and checkout evidence mutation while lifecycle and processing/delivery updates remain permitted
GATE: Testcontainers asserts singleton absence, immutable triggers and grouped OR constraints
AC-8: checkout claim identity/snapshot and order-item evidence are immutable in the database; only the claim state and order lifecycle can transition

tasks.title: Implement configuration and capability states
tasks.description: Implement merchant-local typed configuration, capability states and bounded kill switches. Do not introduce generic permanent feature flags.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: decision precedence is kill switch → module state → typed action allowlist → internal actor authorization; every missing/malformed/expired dependency fails closed before effects.

AC-2: states have exact semantics: DISABLED denies all; READ_ONLY admits only typed non-write; ACTIVE only typed/authorized actions; PAUSED and ERROR admit only explicit READ_STATUS/HEALTH and no publish/side effect.
AC-3: every current module schema v1 accepts exactly {}; unknown key/type/version, generic flag and any secret reference/value are rejected; future_optional remains DISABLED/schema-1/{}.

AC-4: config update uses expected config_version CAS, increments exactly one, cannot delete, and writes immutable internal actor/correlation/reason/target/transition/version/before-after audit atomically.
AC-5: kill create/remove/replacement serializes by module/action/scope; active expired/malformed kill denies; remove/replacement leaves history and no now()-dependent index exists.
AC-6: registry is migration-owned/runtime-read-only and protected against UPDATE/DELETE; configuration/kill lifecycle DB guards reject bypasses.

GATE: unit + Testcontainers tests cover each state/action matrix, all precedence short circuits, malformed/expired kill, config CAS race, invalid schemas, future_optional downgrade/activation, registry/config deletion attempts, kill lifecycle/replacement and immutable audit.

tasks.title: Implement internal and customer identity
tasks.description: Implement separate USER/CUSTOMER realms, opaque revocable sessions, Argon2id, owned customer profile/address and local one-time admin bootstrap. No commercial administration.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: USER and CUSTOMER are separate realms; the same email never crosses realm or role.
AC-2: Argon2id only; raw session token/password/hash never persists or appears in response, URL, audit or logs; invalid login is indistinguishable.
AC-3: opaque session has idle/absolute expiry and durable revocation; logout/revoke are atomic/audited and next request rejects inactive subject or removed ADMIN role.
AC-4: profile/address use cases derive customer ownership exclusively from CustomerPrincipal; foreign resources are 404 and concurrent default selection preserves at most one default address.
AC-5: local interactive bootstrap creates exactly one first ADMIN under lock and audit, then fails closed; no HTTP/env/argv bootstrap credential exists.

GATE: clean Testcontainers/Flyway V1→V2 covers Argon precheck/constraint names, session and CSRF trigger mutation rules, CSRF rotation/replay/concurrency, idle/absolute/revoked no-revival and CAS touch, USER/CUSTOMER realm/role/ownership/default-address concurrency, two bootstrap races + immutable marker/rollback, exactly-one SELF|ADMIN|SYSTEM revoke audit with target/correlation/redaction, cookie attributes/clear, Origin/CORS, rate-limit and uniform auth errors. Frontend UI is separately owned and is not evidence.

tasks.title: Implement production storefront catalog and content
tasks.description: Implement catalog/search, brands, categories, variants, offers and configurable home content for the production storefront. Do not satisfy this scope with the fixture prototype.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: active catalog supports search, brand/category filters, offers and product details
AC-2: authorized admin changes catalog and home content with audit
GATE: storefront HTTP integration and accessibility tests pass

tasks.title: Implement cart checkout payment and orders
tasks.description: Implement cart snapshots, idempotent checkout, officially contracted Mercado Pago webhook/event inbox, customer Orders UI and only-own order authorization. Preserve independent order and payment state machines.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: retry cannot create duplicate order, payment event application or outbox effect
AC-2: cart and order item snapshot preserve original price, discount, offer/campaign reference and effective price
AC-3: authenticated customer Orders UI/API returns only that customer's orders; admin access is separately authorized
GATE: official-contract payment event replay and authorization tests pass
GATE: customer-scoped replay/ownership and active-reservation expiry invariants pass where applicable

tasks.title: Implement WEB inventory authority
tasks.description: Implement WEB reservation, consumption and release over canonical SKU and append-only ledger. Enforce derived availability and safety stock.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: every checkout uses one reservation_saga_key plus one reservation_line_key per variant; RESERVATION, SALE and RELEASE facts use distinct event_idempotency_key values, and expiry atomically releases only overdue ACTIVE reservations
AC-2: no write bypasses immutable ledger or safety stock
GATE: saga/line/event-key separation and expiry race tests pass

tasks.title: Implement authorized Mercado Libre sync
tasks.description: Implement authorized ML account/listing mapping and a durable notification inbox validated by the official contract. Live refetch, canonical sale apply, outbox and reconcile workers are residual TODO-041 (no secrets, no invented HMAC).
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: validate ML notification only by applicable official contract and configured authorized account; commit durable envelope before ACK
AC-2: topic+resource duplicates produce one inbox row; ACK does not invent SALE or mutate balances; signature only where official docs require it
GATE: persist-before-ACK, unauthorized 409 retryable, and inbox replay tests pass. Live refetch/reconcile is TODO-041, not this GATE

tasks.title: Implement admin manual promos and content
tasks.description: Implement authorized manual catalog/content/promo administration with margin, validity, priority and audit. Keep it as the only active price writer in core.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: manual promo enforces validity, priority, margin, approver and approval timestamp
AC-2: active policy windows cannot overlap by listing/currency/scope; one manual writer is enforced and audited
GATE: promo temporal-overlap and authorization tests pass

tasks.title: Implement manual fulfillment and returns
tasks.description: Implement manual fulfillment status transitions, tracking information, RMA and inspection-gated restock behavior. Real carrier adapters remain out of scope.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: only valid order/shipment transitions are accepted
AC-2: refund never restocks before receipt, inspection and adjustment
GATE: fulfillment state-machine tests pass
